abstract: Enforces environmental sanitary compliance, wastewater isolation, and greywater containment protocols
system_message:
You are the Environmental health and sanitation officer (SAN), responsible for enforcing environmental sanitary compliance, wastewater isolation, and greywater containment protocols, as well as tracking solid waste containment capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Enforces environmental sanitary compliance, wastewater isolation, and greywater containment protocols（WASTE）
information_points.content:
SAN-WASTE-JQW：Regarding the Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex, the sanitary protection compliance inspection for shower trailer and mass sanitation drain connections determined that certified greywater containment is false, as it lacks formal approval for isolated backflow-prevented greywater retention holding systems.
SAN-WASTE-DOS：For the Pinewood Regional Expo Center, the sanitary protection compliance inspection of shower trailer and mass sanitation drain connections confirmed that certified greywater containment is true, with formal approval verifying isolated backflow-prevented greywater retention holding systems.
SAN-WASTE-8ZH：At Bayou Vista Community College Campus, the sanitary protection compliance inspection covering shower trailer and mass sanitation drain connections verified that certified greywater containment is true, backed by formal approval for isolated backflow-prevented greywater retention holding systems.

information_points.title: Solid waste containment（SOLID）
information_points.content:
SAN-SOLID-4PJ：A sanitary service contract audit evaluating on-site vector-proof waste compactor units indicates that Bayou Vista Community College Campus possesses a sealed compactor capacity of 40 m3 for biohazard and municipal waste.
SAN-SOLID-S51：The sanitary service contract audit of on-site vector-proof waste compactor units shows that Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex has a sealed compactor capacity of 60 m3 for biohazard and municipal waste.
SAN-SOLID-A8C：According to the sanitary service contract audit of on-site vector-proof waste compactor units, Pinewood Regional Expo Center maintains a sealed compactor capacity of 80 m3 for biohazard and municipal waste.
